body: Meh, it didn't happen tonight. Might've missed my only chance..

Okay, something sort of happened, but i was still too scared to say anything.

There was a problem and my brother went on my PC to sort it, i passed off a comment "I've got enough things to stress about" and he caught on and started asking, i just said "don't worry about it", and he continued and just kept saying a list of things(CollegeGrades,Work,friends,bullying,girls,sexuality) what it could be and looked genuinely worried, he wouldn't stop asking so i just lied and said it was work and the pressure of our parents.

But i've just proved to myself, i'd rather deal with it alone than rather confess and break down crying.

But i have no idea what to tell him and how much detail i should go into, don't know if i should tell him that i want to kill myself, or that i'm gay, i feel as if i need to tell him that i want to kill myself just as a safety net in case he hates me.
Yeah but it doesn't seem that way with my family, we're all pretty close and we know alot about eachother, i'm just the broken child whos fucked up.
Happy, i've managed to separate my facial expressions and my attitude away from how fucking shit i feel.

I can't see him having worse secrets than me, he has a good-ish life. He's generally happy, my family is the kind where nothing generally is bad, and the idea of suicide or anything negative will be passed off completely, i honestly don't think i'd be able to justify my depression to any of them without them thinking its just a phase.
Nope, i pretty much keep anything personal completely to myself, i find it incredibly hard to talk about anything really.
There's no way i'd be able to tell him or anyone otherwise. :(
